core: lineage commitment of myeloid progenitors to granulocytes and monocytes
qualifier: transcriptional programmes of progenitor and promyelocyte stages, not colony-stimulating factor receptor signalling
name: Transcriptional commitment of myeloid progenitors to granulocyte fate
rationale: All members concern the transcriptional control and positive or negative regulation of granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage fate in immature myeloid progenitors; unlike its confusables it carries no CSF/GM-CSF receptor signalling, no monocyte chemokine-receptor trafficking and no erythroid-megakaryocyte arm.

core: epigenetic reprogramming of the germ line and zygote
qualifier: chromatin, imprinting and piRNA-directed retroelement silencing, not maternal mRNA turnover or zygotic genome activation
name: Germline chromatin reprogramming, imprinting and piRNA retroelement silencing
rationale: Every member is a heritable chromatin or genome-silencing event in germ cells or the zygotic pronuclei (X inactivation, imprinting, heterochromatin formation, piRNA-mediated retroelement silencing, protamine-nucleosome exchange); the confusables differ by adding maternal mRNA decay, oocyte construction and zygotic genome activation.

core: monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, membrane and vesicular transport, and enzymatic degradation
qualifier: serotonin, dopamine and noradrenaline handling, excluding cofactor synthesis and adrenergic neuron development
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis, transport and oxidative degradation
rationale: All members are steps in the life cycle of biogenic amine transmitters - biosynthesis, SLC6-mediated uptake and vesicular loading, release, and MAO/COMT breakdown, including the transporter and MAOA disease entries; the confusables instead add tetrahydrobiopterin cofactor synthesis, adrenal and noradrenergic neuron development, or GABA reuptake.

core: phenotypic switching of vascular smooth muscle cells
qualifier: bidirectional control of their proliferation, migration, apoptosis and de/differentiation, not vessel wall remodelling or cardiac muscle
name: Phenotypic switching of vascular associated smooth muscle cells
rationale: Every member regulates the contractile-to-synthetic switch of vascular smooth muscle cells or one of its component behaviours; the confusables are cardiac and striated muscle growth, aortic morphogenesis, endothelial activation and vascular wound healing, none of which appear here.

core: protein entry into and quality control within the endoplasmic reticulum, with the stress signalling it triggers
qualifier: UPR transcription factor branches, translational stress response and ER-to-cytosol retrotranslocation, not COPII export or cytosolic chaperonins
name: Endoplasmic reticulum protein targeting and unfolded protein response
rationale: All members concern insertion, folding, retention or retrotranslocation of proteins at the ER together with the IRE1, PERK/eIF2alpha, ATF6 and CREB3 stress branches and their apoptotic and mitochondrial counterparts; unlike its confusables it excludes COPII/COPI vesicle traffic, the cytosolic HSF1-chaperonin system and FOXO-mediated transcription.

core: staged specification of pancreatic progenitors toward endocrine and exocrine lineages
qualifier: progenitor-stage transcriptional programmes and neuroendocrine fate, not endoderm formation or mature islet hormone secretion
name: Pancreatic progenitor staging and endocrine lineage specification
rationale: Members are successive pancreatic progenitor states (early bud, branching, NEUROG3+ endocrine-committed, mid-progenitor) plus the cell fates they generate and the related neuroendocrine and adrenal programmes; the confusables are definitive endoderm and foregut specification or mature beta-cell insulin and incretin function.

core: collagen synthesis and regulated fibril and matrix assembly
qualifier: biosynthetic and assembly control only, without crosslinking, elastic fibre or degradative steps
name: Collagen biosynthesis and fibril assembly control
rationale: All members are collagen production or the positive and negative regulation of collagen fibril and extracellular matrix assembly; every confusable adds lysyl crosslinking, elastic fibre components, basement membrane or chain trimerization, or matrix metalloproteinase-driven collagen degradation.

core: initiation and execution of chromosomal DNA replication
qualifier: origin firing, unwinding and polymerase activity, not replication checkpoints or the wider G1/S and G2/M transcriptional programme
name: DNA replication initiation and fork progression control
rationale: Every member concerns licensing, initiation, unwinding or polymerase-level progression of replication and the proliferative transcription that accompanies it; the confusables are dominated by ATR and intra-S checkpoint signalling, pre-replicative complex assembly detail, and broad E2F/G2-M cell cycle content absent here.

core: plasma membrane phospholipid redistribution and the lipid-dependent clearance it enables
qualifier: phosphatidylserine exposure with apoptotic cell engulfment and alveolar surfactant lipid handling
name: Membrane phospholipid exposure in apoptotic clearance and surfactant homeostasis
rationale: All members involve translocation or scrambling of membrane phospholipids and the processes that read it - PS display, blebbing, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells and neutrophils, membrane repair, and surfactant lipid secretion and its transporter diseases; the confusables substitute general secretory and mitochondrial housekeeping modules, mechanotransduction, or lung epithelial differentiation.

core: lysosomal glycosaminoglycan degradation blocked in mucopolysaccharidosis
qualifier: Hurler, Hunter, Morquio, Maroteaux-Lamy and Sly forms, excluding the Sanfilippo and Natowicz enzymes
name: Non-Sanfilippo mucopolysaccharidoses blocking glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Each member is a specific mucopolysaccharidosis entry in which a sulfatase or exoglycosidase deficiency halts chondroitin/dermatan, heparan, keratan or hyaluronan breakdown; the confusables are defined by the Sanfilippo (MPS III) and Natowicz (MPS IX) steps and the generic substrate-degradation pathways, none of which belong to this theme.

core: dietary cobalamin absorption and carrier-mediated delivery
qualifier: intrinsic factor and enterocyte uptake, not intracellular cobalamin processing
name: Dietary cobalamin absorption and intrinsic factor transport
rationale: The three members all concern uptake of vitamin B12 from the gut and its transport by binding proteins, including intrinsic factor deficiency; the confusables are intracellular cobalamin trafficking and processing with methylmalonic acidemia, or other water-soluble vitamin pathways.

core: repulsive axon guidance and growth cone collapse
qualifier: semaphorin-plexin and EPH-ephrin signalling with their cytoskeletal effectors, not netrin, slit-ROBO or L1 family cues
name: Semaphorin and ephrin repulsive guidance with growth cone collapse
rationale: All members are repulsive guidance events driven by semaphorin-plexin or EPH-ephrin signalling and the RND1/CRMP/microtubule machinery that executes collapse, fasciculation, pruning and projection patterning; every confusable is distinguished by netrin-DCC, SLIT-ROBO, L1/DSCAM or RAC-CDC42 content that this theme lacks.

core: contractile apparatus of striated muscle with its sarcolemmal adhesion and membrane domains
qualifier: filament assembly, T-tubule, raft and integrin-dystrophin adhesion complexes, not myogenic differentiation
name: Sarcolemmal adhesion complexes and striated muscle contractile machinery
rationale: Members pair thin- and thick-filament assembly, sliding and excitability of cardiac and skeletal muscle with the membrane-cytoskeleton junctions that transmit force (dystrophin-glycoprotein complex, PINCH-ILK-PARVIN focal adhesions, caveolae, rafts, gap junctions, T-tubules); the confusables are myogenic differentiation programmes, SRF-driven cytoskeletal modules or desmosomal junction assembly.

core: chaperonin-assisted folding and stabilization of newly made proteins
qualifier: CCT/TRiC and prefoldin handling of actin, tubulin and G-protein subunits, not degradative clearance or tubulin modification
name: Chaperonin-mediated folding of cytoskeletal and nascent proteins
rationale: All members are folding, refolding, assembly or stabilization events centred on the CCT/TRiC chaperonin and its cofactors acting on cytoskeletal and other nascent substrates; the confusables instead carry aggrephagy, aggresome and ubiquitin-proteasome clearance, or post-translational tubulin modification and severing.

core: lipoamide-dependent 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and the coenzyme A they charge
qualifier: pyruvate, 2-oxoglutarate, 2-oxoadipate and glycine cleavage complexes with lipoylation and CoA synthesis, not branched-chain ketoacid metabolism
name: Lipoamide 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase complexes and coenzyme A supply
rationale: Members are the shared-core 2-oxoacid dehydrogenase reactions (PDH, OGDH, OADH, glycine cleavage, DLD) with their lipoylation machinery, their regulation, the lysine catabolic route that feeds 2-oxoadipate, and pantothenate-to-CoA synthesis; the confusables are defined by branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and BCAA disorders, the TCA cycle proper, or vitamin B6 activation.

core: assembly, cargo delivery and beating of cilia and flagella
qualifier: motile and non-motile axoneme building with intraflagellar and BBSome transport, not cilium disassembly or left-right axis determination
name: Ciliary and flagellar assembly, cargo transport and motility
rationale: Every member builds a cilium or sperm flagellum, delivers cargo into it, or governs its beating and the fluid flow that results; the confusables add cilium disassembly and centriole-centrosome duplication, organ-level left/right asymmetry determination, or tubulin modification and sperm mitochondrial sheath assembly.

core: acidification of secretory and endosomal organelle lumens
qualifier: driven by sodium-proton exchangers, with their neurodevelopmental disease variants, not V-ATPase, bicarbonate or chloride transport
name: Sodium-proton exchanger control of organelle lumen acidification
rationale: All members are organelle lumen pH setting (Golgi, endosome, synaptic vesicle) or the SLC9 Na+/H+ exchangers that set it, including the SLC9A6 and SLC9A9 disease entries; the confusables are built on P-type ATPases, SLC26/SLC4 anion exchange, vacuolar V-ATPase-driven lysosomal acidification or cation-chloride cotransport.

core: cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and survival with regenerative and hypertrophic growth
qualifier: cell-level cardiac muscle growth control, not chamber morphogenesis, fibroblast responses or skeletal myogenesis
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, survival and regenerative growth
rationale: Each member regulates how cardiac muscle cells and myoblasts proliferate, differentiate, resist apoptosis, hypertrophy under stress or regenerate tissue; the confusables are chamber and trabecular morphogenesis, cardiac fibroblast and fibrosis biology, skeletal muscle myogenesis, or sarcomere organization and cardiac adaptation terms absent here.

core: fibroblast growth factor receptor signalling through FRS2 and SHC adaptors with its negative feedback
qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR4 with the betaKlotho co-receptor, not FGFR2 or FGFR3 and not the PI3K or phospholipase C branches
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 FRS and SHC signalling with feedback attenuation
rationale: All members are adaptor-level FGFR signalling events for FGFR1 and FGFR4, their co-receptor-dependent ligand binding, and the Sprouty, FGFRL1 and MAPK feedback that limits them; the confusables are set apart by FGFR2 and FGFR3 paralogue content and by PI3K and phospholipase C cascades that this theme does not contain.

core: biogenesis of the mitochondrial ribosome and chemical modification of mitochondrial transcripts
qualifier: subunit assembly and rRNA/mRNA modification, not transcription, elongation or tRNA processing
name: Mitoribosome assembly and mitochondrial rRNA and mRNA modification
rationale: The members cover assembly of both mitoribosomal subunits, positive control of mitochondrial translation, and rRNA and mRNA modification inside the organelle; the confusables are defined by mitochondrial transcription, translation elongation and termination, mtDNA replication and repair, or tRNA processing and pseudouridylation.

core: negative feedback shutdown of the ERK/MAPK cascade
qualifier: phosphatase-mediated inactivation downstream of ERK, not RAS GAP control or RAF activation
name: Negative feedback inactivation of ERK MAPK signalling
rationale: All members are braking events on the RAS-ERK axis - ERK dephosphorylation and inactivation, tyrosine phosphatase action, RSK-dependent and other feedback loops, suppression of RAS signalling, and the mutants that escape it; the confusables centre on RAS GAPs and RAS/RAF activation steps rather than on feedback termination.

core: loss of beta-catenin destruction complex function in canonical Wnt signalling
qualifier: APC and AXIN1 scaffold lesions, not CTNNB1 phosphosite mutations or receptor-level Wnt regulation
name: Destruction complex scaffold loss in canonical Wnt signalling
rationale: The three members all describe constitutive canonical Wnt/beta-catenin output arising when the APC-AXIN1 destruction complex scaffold fails, together with the hallmark transcriptional response; the confusables are instead CTNNB1 phosphorylation-site mutants, GSK3beta mutants, or ligand- and receptor-level Wnt regulation.

core: specification of the second heart field and formation of ventricles and septa
qualifier: cardioblast fate, proliferation and apoptosis during embryonic heart building, not chamber maturation or endocardial and coronary lineages
name: Second heart field specification and ventricular septal morphogenesis
rationale: Every member is an early cardiogenic step: second heart field specification and cardioblast proliferation, cardiac myoblast differentiation, and morphogenesis of the right ventricle, ventricle and septum including developmental apoptosis; the confusables add adult and atrial chamber maturation, trabeculation, endocardial, coronary and pericardial programmes absent here.

core: clostridial neurotoxin cleavage of SNARE proteins blocking transmitter release
qualifier: serotypes C, D and G only
name: Botulinum neurotoxin serotypes C, D and G cleaving SNAREs
rationale: All three members describe the same molecular event - a botulinum neurotoxin light chain proteolysing a SNARE protein and so blocking synaptic vesicle fusion - for serotypes C, D and G; the confusables are the remaining serotypes A, B and E, or the normal cholinergic release and neuromuscular transmission pathways.

core: fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition and connective tissue replacement after injury
qualifier: the restraining arm, including dampened TGF-beta response and fibroblast apoptosis, in cardiac fibroblasts, not collagen synthesis or fibroblast migration
name: Restraint of myofibroblast transition in fibrotic tissue replacement
rationale: Members all concern scar-forming connective tissue replacement and the fibroblast-myofibroblast decision behind it, weighted toward its limitation - suppressed myofibroblast differentiation, blunted TGF-beta response, pro-apoptotic fibroblast control and reduced matrix assembly, in cardiac fibroblasts; the confusables are fibroblast migration control or the collagen biosynthesis and fibril organization terms that this theme lacks.
